population_and_observation_definition.population: Source-selected British occupational WhitehallII paired phase7/phase9 examinations, initially FPG-defined prediabetes, not the full original baseline cohort or a national sample
population_and_observation_definition.baseline_selection: Static mainPDF physicalp2/printed1386 StudyPopulation; physicalp3/printed1387 StatisticalAnalysis first paragraph. Excludes baseline known diabetes and, for FPG analyses, baseline FPG screen-detected diabetes; requires classifiable paired examinations and source fasting requirements.
population_and_observation_definition.source_measurement: FPG measured in the source clinical OGTT by glucose oxidase; source criterion rules are cited, not re-applied to participants in this aggregate analysis
population_and_observation_definition.source_measurement_locator: Static mainPDF physicalp2 MeasurementsAndDefinitions, continuing onto physicalp3
population_and_observation_definition.endpoint: Terminal source FPG-category label at the phase9 re-examination; not sustained untreated remission or an adjudicated repeated event history
population_and_observation_definition.time: Phase7(2002–2004) to phase9(2007–2009); source calls re-examination approximately5years later. Actual per-person intervals are not in the selected aggregate. Do not assign an exact common clinical horizon or convert to an annual probability.
population_and_observation_definition.clinical_history: Doctor diagnosis outside the study is possible. Baseline known diabetes is excluded, but categorical phase9 priority of doctor diagnosis versus a normal measured FPG and detailed drug histories are not fully specified. The known-phase9-diabetes exclusion belongs to the continuous-change/CVD association analysis and must not be silently transferred to categorical endpoint N.
population_and_observation_definition.history_locator: Static mainPDF physicalpp2–3 MeasurementsAndDefinitions; physicalp3 StatisticalAnalysis fourth paragraph
population_and_observation_definition.death_and_missingness: Phase9 nonattendance/unclassifiable paired examinations are excluded. Published later CVD/death follow-up begins phase9; it is not the competing death/censor partition during the phase7-to9 glycemic interval. Missing outcomes or mortality rows cannot be classified normal/alive.
population_and_observation_definition.death_locator: Static mainPDF physicalp2 last MeasurementsAndDefinitions paragraph continuing physicalp3 top-left; historicalHTML #FPar2 lastparagraph and #FPar3
population_and_observation_definition.cross_criterion_overlap: FPG/2hPG/HbA1c groups overlap. Use FPG only; no pooling or multiplied independent marginal likelihoods.

estimand_and_descriptive_functional.definition: Probability of the source terminal Normoglycaemia label conditional on membership in the retained initial-FPG-prediabetic paired-examination source sample; an observation-level endpoint parameter only
estimand_and_descriptive_functional.point_scope: Finite selected-sample observed label proportion; no individual trajectory, causal effect or annual rate

assumptions: Condition on the selected paired-examination analysis sample and its count N
Treat each endpoint label as an independent Bernoulli realization
Use one constant p for that selected sample; individual risk/selection/visit-time heterogeneity and dependence are not modeled
working_likelihood.empirical_support: The publication does not establish an iid constant-p sampling design or provide dependence/selection/measurement evidence sufficient to validate these working assumptions. British occupational selection and complete-case retention do not become population representative through this calculation.
working_likelihood.log_likelihood: log L(p) = log choose(N,y) + y log(p) + (N-y) log(1-p)
working_likelihood.parameter_domain: 0 <= p <= 1, strict finite numeric input; invalid and nonfinite inputs rejected
working_likelihood.count_domain: strict nonnegative integer literal counts, N>0; no boolean/coerced/rounded counts
working_likelihood.boundary_semantics: 0*log(0)=0 by continuity; impossible boundary events have log likelihood negative infinity, represented by explicit status and JSON-null numerical value, never invalid JSON NaN/Infinity
working_likelihood.comparison: Direct normalized endpoint likelihood evaluation under frozen working assumptions; not reconstruction of the article Poisson/CVD regression, not a Bayesian prior or posterior

interval_design.confidence_level_role: Explicit analysis design choice fixed before planned selected-cell extraction/calculation, after prior/incidental result exposure. Not a reported source confidence interval; root must register/freeze as a design setting.
interval_design.lower: 0 if y=0, otherwise BetaPPF(alpha/2; y, N-y+1)
interval_design.upper: 1 if y=N, otherwise BetaPPF(1-alpha/2; y+1, N-y)
interval_design.coverage_claim: At least the chosen confidence level within the assumed binomial experiment; no empirical coverage claim for selection/dependence/misclassification/treatment ambiguity in this cohort
interval_design.model_free_alternative: Descriptive-only y/N remains available, but uncertainty interval is unavailable outside the declared working model; do not substitute a manufactured sampling distribution.
interval_design.implementation_note: SciPy beta.ppf/binom.logpmf; use locked project version. Current reference documentation version is not a claim about installed runtime version.

annual_rate_nonidentifiability.role: Analytic synthetic-only educational ambiguity demonstration, independent of source counts
annual_rate_nonidentifiability.toy_states: H and P represent toy normal-label and nonnormal-label states, not a full health/disease model
annual_rate_nonidentifiability.rates: a is H→P; b is P→H; a,b nonnegative rates, toy time t>0
annual_rate_nonidentifiability.equation_starting_P: Pr(H at t | P at0) = b/(a+b) * (1-exp(-(a+b)*t)); zero-total-rate limit is0
annual_rate_nonidentifiability.ambiguity: One terminal probability does not determine both a and b. For suitable different positive rate sums, different rate pairs can yield the same endpoint probability.
annual_rate_nonidentifiability.forbidden: Never plug observed Whitehall p_hat into an inverse-rate family or optimize clinical rate witnesses; no annual hazards, no two-state clinical equivalence, no omitted-death claim
annual_rate_nonidentifiability.tests: Registered synthetic fixtures only: conservation/domain/boundary checks and multiple toy rate pairs producing same endpoint; no source-tuned rates

permitted_comparisons: Reported main denominator equals sum of the two ESM N cells

required_main_crosscheck.ignored_in_same_paragraph: Do not capture/register/use progression counts, displayed rounded percentage, subsequent follow-up times, CVD/death counts, rates or p-values. Main crosschecks are duplicated same-source support, not independent observations.
required_main_crosscheck.mismatch_disposition: Saved failed source-reproduction report; preserve ambiguity; never repair a source cell or proceed to claimed agreement
required_main_crosscheck.explicit_normalization: For the selected page3 prefix only: collapse source line breaks/whitespace, then join exact orthographic split pre- diabetes to prediabetes. Preserve FPG-defined hyphen. Do not change source labels, digits, signs, percentages or categories. Locate exactly one source prefix; no fallback to Abstract or another page.
